title: Add backend API routes and startup initialization
description: Initialize payroll snapshot DB during backend startup and expose routes for snapshot capture, list, detail, metadata update, activate, delete, and payroll source query parameters.
convergence: Backend startup initializes staging DB and payroll snapshot DB before listening.
POST /api/payroll/snapshots captures a live snapshot for month/year.
Snapshot routes validate month/year/snapshotId and return clear errors.
